question: Members of Rajya Sabha are elected for the duration of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajya Sabha **is composed of **representatives **of **states **and **union territories**.
 
• The **Rajya Sabha **consists of not **more than two hundred fifty members**.
 
• **Members fall **into **two categories nominated **and **elected**.
 
• **Nominated members **are **twelve **in number and they are **nominated by **the **president **from a person **having special knowledge **of **practical experiments **in matters such as **literature**, **science**, **art**, and **social service**.
 
• **Rajya Sabha **is also known as the **Upper house **or **Council of States**.
 
• The tenure of **Rajya Sabha is six years **where **one-third **of the **total members retire every two years **unlike **Lok sabha **it is **a permanent house **and **not subject to dissolution**.
 
• The **current chairman **of **Rajya Sabha **is **Jagdeep Dhankha**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Lok Sabha**, constitutionally the **House of the People**, is **the lower house of India's bicameral Parliament**, with the **upper house being the Rajya Sabha**. 
 
• The **total Seats **in **Lok Sabha is 543**.
 
• The **current speaker **of **Lok Sabha **is **Oam Birla**.
